Pointers on radio checks in detail
A challenging rush is easier when you know what to expect

Topic: Pet travel checks at Aurelia Skyways

This guide helps you prepare for a smoother trip when you are traveling with an animal. The Companion Animal Travel Desk works with crews and ground staff to keep each step calm, clear, and practical.

Before you arrive, gather the documents your route requires and keep them easy to reach. If your pet has special care needs, share that information early so the team can match the plan to the animal's temperament and comfort. The senior coordinator helps oversee daily service choices, and trained staff give patient attention to every animal.

At the terminal, follow the directions from the desk and be ready to present your booking details and pet records. If you are using the pet relief area at Thornwick, <<FACT F016>>. For travelers connecting through Port Isolde, <<FACT F021>>. These notes help you move through the airport without extra delay.

Try to keep your pet settled with familiar items that are allowed for travel. A calm voice, steady handling, and a simple routine can make a big difference, especially for nervous animals like Baxter. If your plans change, tell the desk as soon as you can so the crew can adjust support where possible.

The department shares practical instructions with crews, so the same care plan follows your animal through the journey. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support before you travel.
